subject.title: fix(sms): replayed Twilio webhooks process again after high inbound traffic

question: Should the SMS webhook fail closed with HTTP 429 when the replay cache is full of live SIDs, even though default Twilio webhook retry policy does not retry 4xx responses?
rationale: The code fix prevents replay protection from weakening, but the saturation response is a delivery-policy tradeoff that current tests cannot settle for production Twilio configurations.

options.title: Accept fail-closed saturation
options.body: Merge this behavior with explicit maintainer acceptance that overflow SMS webhooks can be backpressured or missed unless operators configure Twilio retry or fallback handling.

options.title: Require retry documentation
options.body: Ask for docs or PR evidence explaining Twilio connection override/fallback requirements before relying on 429 as retryable backpressure.

options.title: Request durable replay tracking
options.body: Pause this PR and replace the in-memory saturation behavior with a larger or durable replay ledger if dropping overflow messages is unacceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed saturation
recommendation.body: Merge this behavior with explicit maintainer acceptance that overflow SMS webhooks can be backpressured or missed unless operators configure Twilio retry or fallback handling.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the original SMS channel behavior and can decide the security-versus-delivery policy for saturation.
